blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III on Thursday guaranteed that the passage of an anti-political dynasty law is a congressional priority. Dy made this statement after the Supreme Court (SC) ruled that Congress has a constitutional duty to enact and define a law that prohibits political dynasties. The SC en banc’s unanimous decision was announced by SC Spokesperson Camille Ting on Wednesday. The resolution is in reponse to consolidated petitions filed by groups asking the high court to compel Congress to act on the constitutional duty.
